install: curl -fsSL -o /tmp/node.tar.gz https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.22.3/node-v24.22.3-linux-x64.tar.gz && echo '061ec3e3062115705b56b51fa9cc330ab50d34b6969387d4e4b1a50c6809acc2  /tmp/node.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c - && mkdir -p /opt/node && tar -xzf /tmp/node.tar.gz --strip-components=1 -C /opt/node && ln -s /opt/node/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node && rm /tmp/node.tar.gz

apply: if [ "$INGLENOOK_VARIANT" = day ]; then echo 'theme: light' >> ~/homepage/config/settings.yaml; else echo 'theme: dark' >> ~/homepage/config/settings.yaml; fi
